source.name: archives.yotsubasociety.org (4chan Archived Threads)
source.short-desc: The Yotsuba Society Archives, which held publicly viewable 4chan thread archives, handmade by Jkid. Includes the Moot Video Archive as a bonus. This was obtained from RebeccaBlackTech from an unknown source, possibly direct web scrape.
source.capture: THE UPSTREAM TARBALL IS TRUNCATED. All 17,602,887,852 bytes download and the md5 matches archive.org, so `download` reports success -- but the bytes themselves are broken: `gzip -t` fails with 'invalid compressed data--format violated' on the NAS as well as locally, which means archive.org is hosting a corrupt file rather than the transfer being at fault. About 22.7GB and 1,274,677 tar entries read out before it dies, so most of the site is recoverable; the prepare step deliberately ignores tar's exit code and keeps whatever extracted. Treat coverage as partial and unknown-at-the-tail.

prepare.name: untar the mirrored site (17GB, slow; truncated upstream so tar WILL error near the end)
prepare.run: mkdir -p extracted && { tar xzf source/archives.yotsubasociety.org.tar.gz -C extracted || echo 'tar stopped at the corrupt point, keeping what extracted' >&2; }; [ -d extracted/archives.yotsubasociety.org ]

prepare.name: stage the HTML tree for ingest
prepare.run: rm -rf out && (cp -al extracted/archives.yotsubasociety.org out 2>/dev/null || cp -a extracted/archives.yotsubasociety.org out)
